in_marathi.name: Manilal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Moon God's light
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manilal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mani means moon and Lal means God's light. This name is derived from the Hindu deity Manimuni, the God of wisdom and knowledge. It represents the enlightening and illuminating power of the moon.

in_bengali.name: Manilal
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Moon God's light
in_bengali.long_meaning: Manilal একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Mani means moon and Lal means God's light. This name is derived from the Hindu deity Manimuni, the God of wisdom and knowledge. It represents the enlightening and illuminating power of the moon.
